title: The live station counts only merges inside its window
description: With a week-old merge and a fresh one, /api/flow's 6h and 24h live stations count only the fresh merge, timed from merge to its first serving deploy, while 7d counts both. After a merge deploys, master status shows a 6h live station whose samples are within the window and no 'Live is slow' alert for older merges.

steps.name: after a merge deploys, master status shows a 6h live station within its window and no slow-live alert
